cli.usage.title: VOKO Lite — lightweight pure Node.js edition
cli.usage.invoke_tool: Invoke an MCP tool (JSON output to stdout)
cli.usage.tool_help: Show parameter help for a tool (does not execute)
cli.usage.tools_list: Output JSON Schema of all tools (for agent/MCP client capability discovery)
cli.usage.mcp: stdio MCP proxy (for external MCP clients, transparent port)
cli.usage.update: Upgrade Lite to the latest version
cli.usage.agent: Specify the identity for this operation (most tools need it, e.g. send_message / list_conversations)
cli.usage.agent_env: You can also set the env var VOKO_AGENT_ID; run `voko whoami` to list available agents
cli.usage.verbose: Restore routine logs like DB init (CLI tools are silent by default)
cli.usage.lang: Override UI language (zh/en); defaults to VOKO_LANG / LANG env vars
